title: List the distinct account IDs of clients residing in districts with average
question: List the distinct account IDs of clients residing in districts with average salary above 9,000 who made credit card withdrawals ('VYBER KARTOU') in 1998 with amounts below the average credit card withdrawal amount for that year. Also, include the gap between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001 AS account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.XCL_031) - MIN(d2.XCL_031) FROM district AS d2) AS salary_gap
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON dp.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN trans AS t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE d.XCL_031 > 9000
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_051 < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.XCL_051)
      FROM trans AS t2
      WHERE t2.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', t2.XCL_048) = '1998'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001 AS account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.XCL_031) - MIN(d2.XCL_031) FROM district AS d2) AS salary_gap
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON dp.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN trans AS t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE d.XCL_031 > 9000
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_051 < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.XCL_051)
      FROM trans AS t2
      WHERE t2.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', t2.XCL_048) = '1998'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001 AS account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.XCL_031) - MIN(d2.XCL_031) FROM district AS d2) AS salary_gap
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.XCL_001 = dp.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON dp.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN trans AS t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
WHERE d.XCL_031 > 9000
  AND t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_051 < (
      SELECT AVG(t2.XCL_051)
      FROM trans AS t2
      WHERE t2.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', t2.XCL_048) = '1998'
  )

scope_review.reason: The submitted SQL used district.XCL_030 for 'average salary', but physical evidence shows XCL_030 has values in the hundreds (167, 132, 111, 109, 118), which is inconsistent with a salary threshold of 9,000. In contrast, district.XCL_031 has values in the thousands (85677, 2159, 2824, 5244, 2616), making it the only plausible candidate for 'average salary' that can exceed 9,000. The probe `SELECT XCL_017, XCL_030 FROM district WHERE XCL_030 > 9000` returned 0 rows, confirming XCL_030 cannot satisfy the filter. Therefore, both the filter `d.XCL_030 > 9000` and the gap calculation `MAX(d2.XCL_030) - MIN(d2.XCL_030)` must be changed to use `XCL_031`.
